name: device-ended-reuse-unverified
subject: Permaily ended a device of one of your connections

blocks.text: Permaily ended a device of one of your connections, because a key that device reads with was used twice. That can mean someone copied it.
The app may ask you to connect again: approve it only if you asked for it.
If you don't know why this happened, revoke the connection in Connections at app.permaily.com, and write to support@permaily.com.
